actual_Boolean_family: Every two-input outer Boolean gate and every pair of two-input Boolean children on disjoint physical blocks; additionally every partial physical restriction of each balanced two-bit child paired with a dictator, and one restricted three-bit majority witness
parameter_domain: Outer and child truth-table codes 0 through 15; restrictions in {unfixed,+1,-1}^2
symmetry_reduction: None; all specified truth tables and restrictions are tested
arithmetic: Integer Walsh sums and rational arithmetic; entropy represented exactly as rational linear combinations of logarithms of primes
certificate_scope: Finite identities; all-dimensional claims use analytic proof in REPORT.md
